SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000749
DOCKET NO. F02878814
PLAINTIFF – WILMINGTON SAVINGS FUND SOCIETY, FSB D/B/A CHRISTINA TRUST, NOT INDIVIDUALLY BUT AS TRUSTEE FOR HILLDALE TRUST
DEFENDANTS- JENNIFER WORTHINGTON, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday THE 3rd DAY OF June 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the BOROUGH of SOUTH PLAINFIELD, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 18 BLOCK 228
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
116 GUBERNAT DRIVE SOUTH PLAINFIELD, NJ 07080
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes: LAND AND PREMISES SITUATE IN THE BOROUGH OF SOUTH PLAINFIELD, COUNTY
OF MIDDLESEX AND STATE OF NEW JERSEY, BEING MORE PARTICULARLY
DESCRIBED AS FOLLOWS:
BEGINNING AT A POINT IN THE NORTHWESTERLY SIDELINE OF GUBERNAT DRIVE
(50 FEET WIDE) SAID POINT BEING DISTANT 186.00 FEET SOUTHWESTERLY ALONG
THE SAME, FROM ITS INTERSECTION WITH THE SOUTHWESTERLY SIDELINE OF
PARK AVENUE (60 FEET WIDE), IF BOTH WERE EXTENDED TO SO MEET; FROM
THENCE RUNNING (1) ALONG THE NORTHWESTERLY SIDELINE OF GUBERNAT
DRIVE, SOUTH 73 DEGREES 05 MINUTES 00 SECONDS WEST 65.00 FEET TO AN IRON
PIPE FOUND; THENCE (2) NORTH 16 DEGREES 55 MINUTES 00 SECONDS WEST,
138.76 FEET TO A POINT; THENCE(3) NORTH 69 DEGREES 47 MINUTES 20 SECONDS
EAST, 65.10 FEET TO AN IRON PIPE FOUND; THENCE(4) SOUTH 16 DEGREES 55
MINUTES 00 SECONDS EAST, 142.50 FEET TO THE POINT AND PLACE OF BEGINNING.
COMMONLY KNOWN AS 116 Gubernat Drive, South Plainfield, NJ 07080
PARCEL ID: BLOCK: 228 LOT: 18
UPSET PRICE: $681,705.13
TAXES AND OTHER ENCUMBRANCES:
1st Quarter of 2026 open balance in the amount of $2,141.76.
Sewer open balance in the amount of $218.08, good through 03/01/2026.
Plus interest on these figures through date of pay.
APPROXTMATE DIMENSIONS: 65’ X 140’
BLOCK: 228
LOT: 18
OCCUPANCY STATUS: UNKNOWN.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerks Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $509,500.16 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: April 20, 2026
TIMOTHY D PADGETT, P.A.
6267 OLD WATER OAK ROAD
SUITE 203
TALLAHASSEE, FL 32312
850-422-2520
